models_evaluated: deep learning metastatic disease delineation model

links.outcome: Whether the uncertainty measure tracks degraded image quality, filters false positives, and matches physician-rated likelihood
links.effect: Local Gradients UQ improved false positive filtering ROC AUC by 20.1% and cut the false positive rate by 26%. Correspondence with physician-rated likelihood ROC AUC rose 16.2%. Median lesion change under Gaussian noise was 62.35% vs 2.16%.
links.quote: (3) FP filtering performance was enhanced by the Local Gradients UQ method when compared to the non-gradient methods, increasing the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC) by 20.1% and decreasing the false positive rate by 26%.

unlisted_practices: Post hoc gradient-based uncertainty quantification for imaging segmentation models that does not alter the validated model's output

screen.reason: Evaluates a post hoc uncertainty quantification guardrail added to a deep learning medical imaging model, testing its performance on false positive filtering, response to image degradation, and correspondence with physician ratings.
